notes.title: PATCH 1.3: NIKO UPDATED
notes.content:
[img] http://www.nikodream.com/presskit/Niko_Presskit_files/patch1.3.jpg [/img]


Dear dreamers!
Based on your feedback, we have finished a new update with the following changes:

[list]
    [*]Performance improvements for old computers
    [*]Difficulty adjustments in platforming
    [*]New checkpoints added
    [*]Control sensibility adjustments
    [*]Several graphical improvements
[/list] 


You can leave any comment on the forums, we appreciate your feedback and opinions.
Thank you for helping us making Niko a better game!

notes.title: PATCH 1.2: NIKO CONFIG APPLICATION
notes.content:
Dear dreamers.
You were asking for an improved way to personalize your Niko experience, so we have been working on that. Now you have the Niko Config Application to help you get a better experience.
If you have any comment, suggestion or whatever just use the fórums or contact us (we are always willing to help!!)


[img] http://www.nikodream.com/images/Config0_1.jpg [/img]


[h1] SETTINGS[/h1] 

VIDEO:
- RESOLUTION
- FULLSCREEN
- VSYNC
- FOV

GRAPHICS:
- MSAA
- ONEFRAME THREADLAG
- ANISOTROPIC FILTERING
- AMBIENT OCCLUSION

KEYS:
- KEYBOARD CONFIG
- PAD CONFIG
- MOUSE SMOOTHING
- INVERT MOUSE/PAD
- SPEED MOUSE/PAD

OTHER
- LANGUAGE
- CAMERA BOB


█ LOCATION APP :
It can be launched from the steam library through Config Game Option
